text:
EDR-Bot: alert — HIGH severity: suspicious process chain on jules-mbp (host_id: host-47). Process tree: /usr/bin/python3 -> /tmp/.cache/updater (ELF) -> outbound TLS to 3.120.45.9:443. File quarantined: /tmp/.cache/updater. Detection time: 2026-03-19T14:02:03Z.

jules: omg that's my laptop. I was debugging a CI artifact and ran a helper script from a gist yesterday.

security-oncall: @jules do NOT connect to corp VPN or any internal services from that machine. Can you confirm whether you have any cloud creds or long-lived keys on the device?

jules: I have AWS profile for testing in ~/.aws/credentials (not long-lived but still). Also have a GH token in the local git config for some repos.

samir: isolate the host now — EDR, MDM, and network. @EDR-Bot can we push quarantine?

EDR-Bot: action: network isolation applied at 1930000130 (host-47). Endpoint quarantined: blocked outbound except to management.

security-oncall: good. Next: collect ephemeral forensic artifacts. Jules, run (or paste results) these from another trusted machine or via secure jump: `sudo ps -eo pid,ppid,cmd,etime > /tmp/ps-snapshot.txt` `sudo lsof -nP -p <suspicious_pid> | head` `tar -czf /tmp/forensic-archive.tgz /home/jules/.bash_history /home/jules/.ssh /home/jules/.aws /var/log/system.log` — do NOT upload to personal cloud, put on the forensics host.

jules: copying commands. I can rsync the archive to the forensics VM (10.20.5.12) over the management network.

devops: rotate any tokens that might have been accessible. I'll revoke GH token for jules and disable deploy bot access for his username until we finish. Also please rotate AWS keys and create new short-lived creds.

jules: started rotating GH token now. AWS creds: I'll run `aws sts get-caller-identity` from a clean machine and then request rotation.

security-oncall: Forensics checklist: we need EDR full process dump, `/tmp/.cache/updater` sample (quarantined), bash history, network conntrack, and the output of `netstat -anp` at detection time (if available). Tag the case INC-2026-042.

samir: i've spun up a temporary sandbox to run the quarantined binary for behavioral analysis (isolated net). Lab job id: lab-6621. Do not run it on corp infra.

jules: FYI the gist I pulled was linked from a private slack thread, might be a supply chain compromise. I'll message the repo owner.

security-oncall: good catch. Add supply-chain note to the ticket. Also we should check CI runner logs for `npm`/`pip` pulls in the last 48h.

EDR-Bot: collected agent logs and uploaded bundle to secure artifacts at s3://redwood-forensics/INC-2026-042/edr-bundle-1930000135.tgz (access controlled).

devops: confirmed GH token revoked and deploy bot access suspended for jules. AWS keys rotation requested with IAM.

security-oncall: decision: re-image device once forensics snapshot is taken. Endpoint re-enroll only after MDM baseline and AV clean scan. Also rotate SSH keys used from that device.

jules: understood. I'll schedule re-image with IT for tomorrow morning and hand over the device to forensics if needed.

samir: quick remediation note for prod owners — we queried CloudTrail for suspicious IP 3.120.45.9 and saw no IAM calls from jules' creds. Still proceed with rotation.

security-oncall: final actions checklist (short): 1) isolate (done) 2) collect forensic archive (in progress) 3) revoke/rotate tokens (in progress) 4) run behavioral analysis in sandbox (samir) 5) re-image and re-enroll (planned) 6) postmortem and supply-chain outreach.

jules: thanks all. i'll stay offline until re-image.

devops: filing follow-up tasks in incidents: INC-2026-042 and adding owners.

security-oncall: closing loop here — we'll post a short summary in #incidents after forensics complete. :white_check_mark:

samir: thumbs up. :thumbsup:

EDR-Bot: note: thread closed for updates at 1930000180.
